'''Van Melancon hidden base +numbers= joy''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Van Melancon]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-1699">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1699 hidden base +numbers= joy], DeckTech (van "nocnalemeel" melancon, 16 December 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/1699/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/1699/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018220324/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1699/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Van Melancon]]
* '''Published:''' 16 December 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''hidden base +numbers= joy''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HBNJ Melancon LS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Basically, this deck is good hidden base with numbers for a little extra punch for the unprepared.The droids , even against a 3 or4 torture deck are usually useful somehow if you are crafty.

== Original post ==

'''hidden base +numbers= joy'''
* '''Author:''' van "nocnalemeel" melancon
* '''Published:''' December 16, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Basically, this deck is good hidden base with numbers for a little extra punch for the unprepared.The droids , even against a 3 or4 torture deck are usually useful somehow if you are crafty.

=== Strategy ===

this deck has a shot against just about anything.... it has lots of battle strength and the numbers are like a bonus....when i start haven, i can deploy quickly and have enouigh generation for the ground if I have to.The savrip works well and numbers are a bonus(forfiet those droids) but be careful how u use it or u may get screwed....... if you play carefully this deck can beat most decks
